[[File:Star Wars CCG original logo.png|thumb|right|180px|Original SWCCG logo.]]
'''Star Wars CCG''' (also ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game, SWCCG / SW:CCG) is the customizable card game published by [[Decipher|Decipher, Inc.]] from December 1995 through 2001.<ref name="wp">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016121021/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Internet Archive]</ref>

The game is based on the ''Star Wars'' franchise. After Decipher lost the license, volunteer [[Players Committee]] support continued organized play and later virtual cards.

== History ==

'''[[History of Star Wars CCG]]''' is the full timeline. It runs from Decipher's printed sets through the Players Committee's virtual sets and the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]]. Related articles: [[Decipher]], [[Decipher and the Star Wars CCG Lucasfilm license]], [[Decipher after the Star Wars license]], [[History of the Players Committee]], [[Cancelled Expansions]] and [[Related games]].

== Playing ==

New players can start with [[Getting Started]] and [[How to play]]. Rules documents are on [[Rules]] and [[Rulebooks]]; organized-play pools are on [[Formats]]. Players use Force to deploy characters, starships and other cards. They can drain the opponent's Force at locations they control.<ref name="star-wars-decipher-rules">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/rulebookv2.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook], Decipher, November 1998. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022044421/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/rulebookv2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The game is played online on [[GEMP]]. [[TCGMix]] also offers a [https://tcgmix.com/starwars/ browser prototype] with rooms, bot games and public card and deck browsing.<ref name="star-wars-tcgmix">[https://tcgmix.com/starwars/ Star Wars CCG on TCGMix]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107172027/https://tcgmix.com/starwars/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Creators ==

The game's designers were [[Tom Braunlich]], [[Rollie Tesh]], [[Warren Holland]] and [[Jerry Darcy]].<ref name="wp" /> See [[Creators of SWCCG]].

== Expansions ==

Decipher released printed expansions from [[Premiere Limited]] (December 1995)<ref name="dec-exp">[https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions] at Decipher.com (archive, 4 May 1999)</ref> to [[Theed Palace]] (December 2001); the Players Committee has released virtual sets since 2002. See [[Sets]] and the set tiles on the [[Main Page]].
